name: Filter
whenToUse: Narrowing a list or table by a few facets: status, region, owner.
Several values per facet, with counts per option.

anatomy.description: facet name; with a selection shows the count (“Status, 2”); `heightSize` sm/md/lg.
checkbox options with counts; `searchable` for long lists.

do.caption: One trigger per facet; several values each; counts say how many match.

dont.caption: A select as a filter: one status at a time and a fake “All” option.
dont.example:
<Select defaultValue="all">
  <SelectTrigger widthSize="md" aria-label="Status">
    <SelectValue />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="all">All statuses</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="active">Active</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="suspended">Suspended</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="pending">Pending</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>

a11y: The trigger is a button whose name includes the selection count (“Status, 1 selected”).
Options are a named checkbox group; Space toggles.
Announce the new result count on the page when filters change.

props.name: label
props.description: The facet name shown on the trigger, e.g. "Status".

props.name: heightSize
props.description: Trigger height (and search-field height, when `searchable`) — matches TextField/Select/Toggle/Button's shared scale. sm 32px, body-s | md (default) 40px, body-m | lg 48px, body-m.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a search box above the list (for facets with many options).
